blockers.quote: She has not moved: same mop, same breath, mouth open mid-word. The thumbnail's frame, exactly, locked at 0:06.
blockers.why: Check #2 Confirm the click fails: packaging.md shows the long-stare frame, while this draft claims a different juggling frame and delays her stunned reaction until after 0:06.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "Her jaw drops mid-word; the mop starts sliding. The 365 counter, your juggling and her stunned face lock together at 0:06: the thumbnail frame." Update packaging.md to that identical frame.

blockers.quote: > SCENE: The hall doorway at the foot of the stairs. Your boss steps into it, grinning, a new coil of cable in both hands. On its end, two plugs. Cut before your face.
blockers.why: Check #12 Leave fast fails: this creates another image after the declared last image, so the real closing line at line 352 is no longer inside the last image.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "> SCENE: Keep the last image uncut. Behind the two of you in neighbouring pods, your boss enters the hall doorway, grinning, with a two-plug cable. Cut before your face."

blockers.quote: Night one hundred and twenty-three. You've outlived the longest verified human life (c27). And you're still on the night shift.
blockers.why: Check #5 But / therefore fails: after the monopoly collapses and governments react, the story simply jumps forward. Nothing causes you to keep plugging in, so the post-climax section begins with “and then.”
blockers.fix: Replace with: "You broke your boss's monopoly. But you also made plugging in ordinary, even for yourself. Night one hundred and twenty-three: you've outlived the longest verified human life (c27). And you're still on the night shift."

suggestions.quote: And all of them went into the same town you did. Inside is filling up.

suggestions.quote: Only what's in your head comes back. A design is in your head.

keep.quote: One night for her. One year for you. And you spent it learning to juggle.
He's not wrong. Out here, you're the guy who can juggle.
By the weekend, three governments ban kettles. By Monday, they un-ban them. The ministers plugged in.
